theme.label: Theme
theme.help: Interface theme. Choose to follow the system, light, dark, etc.

default_mode.label: Default Mode
default_mode.help: Default mode. agent for normal conversation, plan for planning mode, yolo for direct output mode.

sidebar_focus.label: Sidebar Focus
sidebar_focus.help: Sidebar focus behavior. pinned keeps the sidebar fixed, auto toggles visibility, tasks, agents, context, hidden.

mention_menu_behavior.label: Mention Menu Behavior
mention_menu_behavior.help: Menu behavior when {'@'}mentioning files. fuzzy for fuzzy search, browser to list subdirectories in the current directory.

cost_currency.label: Cost Currency
cost_currency.help: Cost display currency. usd for USD, cny/rmb/yuan are normalized to CNY.

verbosity.label: Verbosity
verbosity.help: Output verbosity. normal for standard conversation style, concise for brief low-redundancy output.

show_thinking.label: Show Thinking
show_thinking.help: Whether to display the model's reasoning/thinking content in conversation history.

show_tool_details.label: Show Tool Details
show_tool_details.help: Whether to expand and display detailed parameters and results for each tool call.

auto_compact.label: Auto Compact
auto_compact.help: Model-aware, enabled by default. Automatically generates a summary and replaces old content when context approaches the model window limit.

paste_burst_detection.label: Paste Burst Detection
paste_burst_detection.help: Enabled by default. Detects bulk paste in terminals that do not support bracketed-paste, preventing character-by-character completion triggers.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.label: Auto Compact Threshold
auto_compact_threshold_percent.help: Default 80. Triggers auto-compaction when active request input estimation reaches this percentage of the model context window.

mention_menu_limit.label: Mention Menu Limit
mention_menu_limit.help: Maximum number of candidate files to keep in the {'@'} popup, excess is truncated, default 128.

mention_walk_depth.label: Mention Walk Depth
mention_walk_depth.help: Maximum directory depth for {'@'} completion to traverse the workspace. 0 means unlimited depth, default 6.

max_input_history.label: Max History
max_input_history.help: Number of submitted input history to retain, cleared drafts are still kept for history search, default 100.

background_color.label: Background Color
background_color.help: Custom background color for TUI root, header, conversation history, and footer; default uses the theme default.

default_model.label: UI Default Model
default_model.help: Default model ID for the current session (overrides engine default). Leave empty to use the engine default model.

thinking_default_expanded.label: Thinking Block Default Expanded
thinking_default_expanded.help: When show_thinking is on, whether to expand thinking blocks by default

inline_diffs.label: Inline Diff Display
inline_diffs.help: Show full red/green diff and semantic stats. full: complete diff; summary: stats only; off: quiet result

focus_texture.label: Focus Texture
focus_texture.help: Background texture outside modal views. off: no texture; scrim: mask

work_surface_placement.label: Work Surface Placement
work_surface_placement.help: Work surface located above conversation history, left, right, or hidden

rail_panel.label: Work Surface Default Panel
rail_panel.help: Panel displayed by default on the work surface. tasks: task list; agents: subagents; context: context; pinned: goals+todos

sessions_rail.label: Sessions Rail
sessions_rail.help: Whether to display the sessions rail

session_auto_resume.label: Auto Resume Session
session_auto_resume.help: Whether to automatically resume the last session

launch_screen.label: Launch Screen
launch_screen.help: Whether to display the launch screen

work_surface_top_height.label: Top Work Surface Height Limit
work_surface_top_height.help: Maximum height of the top work surface (2~16)

work_surface_side_width.label: Side Work Surface Width Limit
work_surface_side_width.help: Maximum width of the side work surface (26~80)
